variables.label: YTS administration year
variables.definition: Even-numbered year in which the Delaware school-based survey was administered.
variables.comparability_notes: Survey availability and instrument content vary by year; 2020 and other pandemic-era collection conditions should be checked in the year-specific instrument/report.

variables.label: Student grade
variables.definition: Grade of the participating student; the published universe spans grades 6 through 12.
variables.universe: Random sample of students in grades 6-12 in Delaware school districts
variables.geography: Delaware; district/school estimates may be restricted
variables.suppression_rules: No Delaware public-use suppression rule was located; school/district microdata availability is not documented on the YTS archive page.
variables.comparability_notes: Do not equate with CDC NYTS middle-school/high-school grouping without recoding grades consistently.

variables.label: Tobacco-use behavior
variables.definition: Questionnaire measures of student behaviors associated with tobacco use. Exact product, ever-use, current-use and frequency fields must be read from the applicable Delaware questionnaire.
variables.time_granularity: survey administration; recall period is item-specific
variables.comparability_notes: A national convention often defines current use as use on at least 1 of the past 30 days, but that definition is not assigned to a Delaware field until verified in the year-specific Delaware instrument.

variables.label: Exposure to secondhand smoke
variables.definition: Questionnaire measures assessing exposure to smoke produced by other people's tobacco use.
variables.comparability_notes: Keep home, vehicle, school and public-place exposure items separate if the questionnaire distinguishes them.

variables.label: Exposure to tobacco marketing
variables.definition: Questionnaire measures of exposure to or recognition of tobacco-industry marketing.
variables.comparability_notes: Marketing channel and product categories can change materially across survey years, especially with electronic cigarettes.

variables.label: Participation in tobacco-prevention programs
variables.definition: Questionnaire measures indicating whether a student participated in tobacco prevention programming.
variables.comparability_notes: Participation is an exposure to programming, not evidence of program effectiveness; compare only after matching program definition and recall period.

crosswalk_hints.notes: Crosswalk to NYTS only after matching product, recall window, threshold (ever/current/frequent), grade universe, weighting and survey year.
Program participation is not comparable to service utilization counts unless both count the same student-level exposure and period.

sources.research_notes: Delaware questionnaires are publicly indexed, but a Delaware consolidated codebook with stable variable names, value labels, weights, design variables and missing-value codes was not found. The exact Delaware field mapping must therefore be extracted questionnaire-by-questionnaire or requested with the microdata. National NYTS documentation is authoritative for NYTS, but is only a comparison aid and was not used to invent Delaware field names.

variables.label: General health
variables.definition: Parent/caregiver rating of the selected child's health in general.
variables.universe: Selected noninstitutionalized child age 0-17; all topical questionnaire versions
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
missing_codes: Item nonresponse/valid skip are represented per release-format codebook
variables.suppression_rules: Public-use recoding/suppression is variable-specific and documented in the annual codebook.
variables.comparability_notes: Subjective parent report; not interchangeable with diagnosed conditions or claims-based morbidity.

variables.label: Current depression
variables.definition: Whether the selected child currently has depression, conditional on ever being told the child had depression.
variables.universe: Age-version-eligible selected children with K2Q32A not equal to No
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
variables.suppression_rules: Check public-use codebook and estimate reliability before subgroup publication.
variables.comparability_notes: Current diagnosed condition, not a symptom screen; universe differs from measures asked of all children.

variables.label: Current anxiety problems
variables.definition: Whether the selected child currently has anxiety problems, conditional on ever being told the child had anxiety problems.
variables.universe: Age-version-eligible selected children with K2Q33A not equal to No
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
variables.suppression_rules: Check public-use codebook and estimate reliability before subgroup publication.
variables.comparability_notes: Current diagnosed problem, not general distress or service use.

variables.label: Current autism or autism spectrum disorder
variables.definition: Whether the selected child currently has autism or autism spectrum disorder, conditional on ever being told the child had it.
variables.universe: Age-version-eligible selected children with K2Q35A not equal to No
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
variables.suppression_rules: Check public-use codebook and estimate reliability before subgroup publication.
variables.comparability_notes: Parent-reported diagnosed status; not equivalent to administrative special-education eligibility.

variables.label: Current asthma
variables.definition: Whether the selected child currently has asthma, conditional on ever being told the child had asthma.
variables.universe: Selected children with K2Q40A not equal to No
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
variables.suppression_rules: Check public-use codebook and estimate reliability before subgroup publication.
variables.comparability_notes: Current parent-reported diagnosed asthma differs from encounter diagnoses and lifetime asthma.

variables.label: Usual place for sick care or health advice
variables.definition: Whether there is a place the child usually goes when sick or when health advice is needed.
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
variables.comparability_notes: Access measure, not a count of visits or guarantee of primary care continuity.

variables.label: Preventive visits in past 12 months
variables.definition: Recoded number of preventive medical visits during the past 12 months.
variables.universe: Selected child; logically skipped when the questionnaire establishes no relevant care in S4Q01
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
variables.suppression_rules: Public-use recode collapses higher visit counts to 2 or more.
variables.comparability_notes: Survey-reported visits and top-coded category; not directly comparable to raw Medicaid encounter counts.

variables.label: Needed health care but did not receive it
variables.definition: Whether during the past 12 months the child needed medical, dental, vision or mental health care but did not receive it.
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
variables.comparability_notes: Composite unmet-need indicator; do not interpret as a specific service type without companion items.

variables.label: Neighborhood library or bookmobile
variables.definition: Whether the child's neighborhood contains a library or bookmobile.
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
variables.comparability_notes: Perceived neighborhood availability, not library usage, circulation or distance.

variables.label: Child is safe in neighborhood
variables.definition: Level of agreement that the child is safe in the neighborhood.
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
variables.comparability_notes: Perceived safety is not equivalent to police-recorded crime, crash or traffic-enforcement events.

variables.label: Household food situation
variables.definition: Household's ability to afford enough food during the past 12 months.
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
categories: Enough but not always desired types
variables.comparability_notes: A household food-situation response, not a USDA multi-item food-security scale and not a service-use count.

variables.label: Received SNAP or food stamps
variables.definition: Whether anyone in the family received SNAP or food-stamp benefits at any time during the past 12 months.
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
variables.comparability_notes: Any family receipt during 12 months, not monthly caseload, benefit amount or person-month enrollment.

variables.label: Current Medicaid or public assistance coverage
variables.definition: Whether the child's current health coverage is Medicaid, Medical Assistance or another government assistance plan for persons with low incomes or disability.
variables.universe: Currently insured selected children; logically skipped when current coverage is No
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
missing_codes: Logical skip for children without current coverage
variables.comparability_notes: Parent-reported coverage category; not equivalent to an administrative Medicaid eligibility month or to service-system category MCO/FFS.

variables.label: Family structure
variables.definition: Public-use recode of the selected child's family/parental structure.
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
categories: Two parents, at least one not biological/adoptive, married
Two parents, at least one not biological/adoptive, unmarried
variables.suppression_rules: This is a public-use recode; use categories as released and do not reconstruct more detailed family relationships.
variables.comparability_notes: Household structure differs from benefit case composition, homeless household type and foster placement type.

variables.label: State FIPS code
variables.definition: Federal Information Processing Series code for the child's state of residence.
categories: 01-56 valid state/DC FIPS values represented in the release
variables.suppression_rules: Public-use geography is state-level; finer residence geography is not represented by FIPSST.
variables.comparability_notes: Use 10 for Delaware; align with other state FIPS fields rather than state abbreviations.

variables.label: Multiply imputed family poverty ratio
variables.definition: Six implicates of family income as a percentage of the federal poverty level.
variables.geography: United States, states and District of Columbia
categories: 50 or less through 400 or more; numeric range is bounded in public use
missing_codes: Use all six implicates and the official imputed-data procedure
variables.suppression_rules: Public-use values are bounded; analysis must combine implicates rather than selecting one as final.
variables.comparability_notes: Income-to-poverty ratio is not benefit eligibility, EITC receipt or dollar income. Federal poverty thresholds and imputation model vary by survey year.

crosswalk_hints.notes: Compare to Delaware Medicaid administrative enrollment only as survey coverage prevalence versus administrative person-months; denominators and reference time differ.
Keep food situation, SNAP receipt and poverty separate. They may be related but measure distinct constructs.
Neighborhood library availability is not comparable to Delaware Libraries circulation, program attendance or patron sessions.
Separate usual source, preventive use and unmet need; each has a different denominator and recall window.

sources.research_notes: The Census Bureau, which conducts the survey, publishes comprehensive annual field documentation. CAHMI provides indicator-oriented access, but exact public-use variable coding should be taken from Census. The redesigned annual NSCH beginning in 2016 should not be trended against pre-2016 NSCH without explicit methodological treatment. Use survey weights/design variables and reliability rules for estimates; use all six poverty implicates for FPL analyses.

variables.label: Unique child identifier
variables.definition: Public-use sequence number uniquely identifying the sampled child record.
variables.suppression_rules: Identifier is survey-specific and not linkable to external identity.
variables.comparability_notes: Do not treat as a stable longitudinal person identifier.

variables.label: Adequate provider data indicator
variables.definition: Indicates whether sufficiently complete provider-reported vaccination data were obtained for the child.
variables.comparability_notes: Provider-based coverage variables generally require PDAT; denominator differs from all household-interview respondents.

variables.label: Final provider-phase sampling weight
variables.definition: Final weight for analyses of children with adequate provider data; the continental-U.S./state analytic weight excludes territories as documented.
variables.geography: United States/states under the documented weight scope
variables.comparability_notes: Use with design variables and the correct domain; not interchangeable with household-interview weights.

variables.label: Sampling stratum
variables.definition: Public-use stratum variable for variance estimation under the NIS complex sample design.
variables.suppression_rules: Public-use design coding may combine or mask operational strata.
variables.comparability_notes: Use only with documented survey-design procedures, not as a substantive geography.

variables.label: Age group
variables.definition: Age group of the sampled young child at interview.
variables.comparability_notes: Coverage assessed by a milestone age (for example by 24 or 36 months) is distinct from age at interview.

variables.label: True state of residence FIPS code
variables.definition: State-of-residence code used for state estimates.
variables.suppression_rules: Finer location is not implied by this state field.
variables.comparability_notes: Crosswalk directly to NSCH FIPSST after aligning year and population universe.

variables.label: Race/ethnicity of child
variables.definition: Public-use combined race and Hispanic ethnicity classification for the child.
categories: Use exact 2024 codebook labels; public-use categories combine race and Hispanic origin
variables.suppression_rules: Public-use category detail is constrained by disclosure/reliability considerations.
variables.comparability_notes: Do not merge with HUD's 2025 race/ethnicity categories without an explicit many-to-one crosswalk; category standards differ.

variables.label: Income-to-poverty category
variables.definition: Household income relative to poverty, categorized for vaccination-coverage analysis.
variables.comparability_notes: Can be conceptually aligned to NSCH FPL implicates only after matching thresholds; NIS field is categorical and not the same imputation structure.

variables.label: Number of diphtheria/tetanus/pertussis-containing doses by 36 months
variables.definition: Provider-reported count of qualifying DT-containing vaccine doses received by 36 months of age.
variables.geography: United States, state and estimation-area analyses
missing_codes: . = no adequate provider data, as documented
variables.suppression_rules: Published estimates are subject to CDC reliability criteria; consult report footnotes.
variables.comparability_notes: Dose count differs from series-up-to-date indicator P_UTDTP4 and from doses recorded only in a state registry.

variables.label: At least 4 DT-containing doses by 36 months
variables.definition: Indicator that provider records show four or more qualifying DT-containing doses by 36 months.
variables.geography: United States, state and estimation area
variables.suppression_rules: Estimate suppression/reliability flags are applied in publication products, not encoded by this binary alone.
variables.comparability_notes: Match antigen, required dose count and age cutoff exactly; not a general 'fully vaccinated' measure.

variables.label: At least 3 poliovirus doses by 36 months
variables.definition: Indicator that provider records show at least three qualifying poliovirus vaccine doses by 36 months.
variables.geography: United States, state and estimation area
variables.suppression_rules: Publication reliability rules apply.
variables.comparability_notes: Match dose threshold and cutoff age before comparing to registry or claims measures.

variables.label: At least 1 measles-containing dose by 36 months
variables.definition: Indicator that provider records show one or more qualifying measles-containing vaccine doses by 36 months.
variables.geography: United States, state and estimation area
variables.suppression_rules: Publication reliability rules apply.
variables.comparability_notes: Measles-containing vaccine may be MMR or another qualifying formulation; use CDC definition.

variables.label: At least 3 hepatitis B doses by 36 months
variables.definition: Indicator that provider records show at least three qualifying hepatitis B vaccine doses by 36 months.
variables.geography: United States, state and estimation area
variables.suppression_rules: Publication reliability rules apply.
variables.comparability_notes: Do not confuse with P_UTDHEPA1/P_UTDHEPA2, which refer to hepatitis A.

variables.label: Hepatitis A dose-series indicators
variables.definition: Provider-based indicators for at least one and at least two qualifying hepatitis A doses by the codebook-defined age cutoff.
variables.geography: United States, state and estimation area
variables.suppression_rules: Publication reliability rules apply.
variables.comparability_notes: Keep the one-dose and two-dose thresholds separate; neither is interchangeable with hepatitis B field P_UTDHEP.

variables.label: Combined 4:3:1:3:3:1:4 vaccine series
variables.definition: Indicator that the child is up to date for the specified combined vaccine series: 4 DTaP, 3 polio, 1 measles-containing, 3 Hib, 3 hepatitis B, 1 varicella and 4 pneumococcal conjugate doses under CDC rules.
variables.geography: United States, state and estimation area
variables.suppression_rules: Publication reliability rules apply.
variables.comparability_notes: The compact series name encodes dose counts; compare only to a combined-series measure with the identical antigens, counts and age cutoff.

variables.label: At least 2 influenza doses by 24 months with minimum spacing
variables.definition: Indicator for two or more influenza vaccine doses by 24 months, with doses separated by at least the codebook-defined interval (four weeks less four days).
variables.geography: United States, state and estimation area
variables.suppression_rules: Publication reliability rules apply.
variables.comparability_notes: Spacing rule is part of the definition; do not compare with any-two-flu-doses counts that ignore interval.

variables.label: WIC participation history/current participation
variables.definition: Household interview indicators for whether the child ever received WIC and whether the child currently receives WIC, as separately coded.
variables.universe: NIS-Child interviewed children subject to questionnaire routing
variables.comparability_notes: WIC receipt is an assistance-program indicator, not vaccination coverage or a count of WIC service encounters.

crosswalk_hints.notes: STATE can align to NSCH FIPSST; age must remain 19-35-month bands rather than generic child age.
Normalize as weighted share of eligible children only after preserving each antigen, dose threshold, milestone age, provider-data restriction and spacing rule.
Can contextualize WIC/DHSS sources, but the NIS fields are survey responses and do not measure administrative WIC caseload or outcomes.

sources.research_notes: The public-use codebook is complete and supports exact field-level analysis. ChildVaxView may combine multiple estimate products; the NIS-Child public-use file applies to children 19-35 months, while an interactive title may refer more broadly to young children. Use provider-phase weights/design variables and published reliability flags. Provider-reported dose histories, milestone-age logic and combined-series definitions are central comparability constraints.

variables.label: Academic year
variables.definition: Academic year to which prices, budgets or other annual measures apply (for example 2025-26).
missing_codes: Blank/not shown in table-specific workbook cells
variables.suppression_rules: No universal suppression rule; inspect each table note.
variables.comparability_notes: Do not merge with tax/calendar year without a documented year mapping; some most-current values are preliminary/projected.

variables.label: Institution sector
variables.definition: Institution classification such as public two-year, public four-year or private nonprofit four-year, with residency basis where applicable.
variables.universe: Title IV degree-granting institutions or report-specific universe
variables.suppression_rules: Table-specific category availability.
variables.comparability_notes: Residency basis is part of the category; do not average in-state and out-of-state prices without enrollment weights.

variables.label: Average published tuition and fees
variables.definition: Published sticker price for tuition plus mandatory fees for full-time undergraduate attendance, averaged using the report's table-specific weighting.
variables.universe: Full-time undergraduate price observations in the stated sector
variables.suppression_rules: No universal rule stated; table notes identify exclusions/estimates.
variables.comparability_notes: Published price is not institutional cost and not what students actually pay; distinguish current dollars from inflation-adjusted dollars.

variables.label: Average housing and food charge/budget
variables.definition: Published institutional housing-and-food charge for on-campus students or estimated allowance where the table specifies another living arrangement.
variables.comparability_notes: On-campus charges and off-campus budget allowances are different constructs; retain living arrangement.

variables.source_variable_name: Books and supplies / Transportation / Other expenses
variables.label: Non-tuition student budget components
variables.definition: Estimated allowances for books/materials and supplies, transportation, and other personal expenses used in the full student expense budget.
variables.universe: Students represented by the table and living arrangement
variables.comparability_notes: These are budget allowances, not necessarily observed expenditures; keep each component separate.

variables.label: Average total undergraduate budget
variables.definition: Sum of published tuition and fees, housing and food, books/materials and supplies, transportation and other expenses for the specified sector/living arrangement.
variables.universe: Full-time undergraduates represented by the table
variables.comparability_notes: Total budget is broader than published tuition and fees and may contain estimated living allowances.

variables.source_variable_name: Estimated net tuition and fees / Estimated net total budget
variables.label: Estimated net price measures
variables.definition: Estimated price remaining after subtracting grant aid and education tax benefits, reported separately for tuition/fees and for total budget.
variables.unit: U.S. dollars per full-time first-time undergraduate per academic year
variables.universe: First-time full-time undergraduates in the report-defined sector/sample
variables.comparability_notes: Net price is an estimate after grant aid/tax benefits, not a family's cash payment; denominator differs from published-price averages.

variables.label: Current or inflation-adjusted dollars
variables.definition: Indicator/section context identifying whether money values are nominal current dollars or converted to constant dollars using the report's inflation adjustment.
variables.comparability_notes: Never compare or aggregate nominal and constant-dollar series without conversion to one base.

source_variable_names: Estimated net tuition and fees / Estimated net total budget
crosswalk_hints.notes: Keep sticker price, full budget and net price separate; potential comparison to income/EITC requires a consistent dollar year and household denominator.
Cross-dataset comparisons must map academic year to calendar/tax/fiscal year and normalize all dollar series to the same price basis.

sources.research_notes: College Board publishes a detailed report and Excel companion tables rather than a conventional rectangular dataset codebook. Table titles, notes, sources and workbook layout are therefore the published dictionary. Workbook sheets can change between vintages; automated ingestion should capture sheet name, table number, row label, column label, sector, geography, year and dollar basis rather than assuming stable cell coordinates.

codebook_artifacts.title: Statistics for Tax Returns with the Earned Income Tax Credit
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Tax-year EITC claims processed through the stated IRS processing cycle
codebook_artifacts.notes: The page itself supplies the table schema, tax year, processing cutoff, units/rounding and transaction-code source note; no separate downloadable data dictionary was located.

variables.label: Tax year
variables.definition: Tax year of the returns represented by the table (current page section: tax year 2024, processed in 2025).
variables.universe: Returns with EITC captured by the stated processing cycle
variables.geography: United States, states, territories/other rows as published
variables.suppression_rules: Values are displayed in rounded K/M/B notation rather than exact microdata counts/dollars.
variables.comparability_notes: Tax year is not publication year or processing year; compare same tax-year vintage and cutoff.

variables.label: IRS processing cutoff
variables.definition: Point through which returns/transactions were processed for the published table; the tax-year 2024 table cites December 2025 and processing cycle 202553.
variables.comparability_notes: Later processing cycles can add/amend returns; do not treat two vintage snapshots as identical annual totals.

variables.label: Jurisdiction abbreviation
variables.definition: Published abbreviation for the state or other geographic row.
variables.universe: Rows in the EITC statistics table
categories: DE for Delaware; other abbreviations as published
variables.comparability_notes: Normalize to FIPS only with an explicit lookup; national/foreign/territorial summary rows may not have state FIPS equivalents.

variables.label: Jurisdiction name
variables.definition: Full published name of the state or other jurisdiction/summary row.
variables.universe: Rows in the EITC statistics table
variables.comparability_notes: Retain both State and Abbreviation to distinguish non-state summary rows.

variables.label: EITC claim count
variables.definition: Number of tax returns/claims with EITC reflected in the published IRS extraction.
variables.universe: EITC claims processed through the stated cycle
variables.suppression_rules: Displayed counts are rounded, commonly using K (thousands); exact values are not supplied by the HTML table.
variables.comparability_notes: A claim/return is not a person, child, household member or monthly benefit case. One return may represent multiple family members.

variables.label: Total net EITC amount
variables.definition: Aggregate net EITC amount for the jurisdiction, sourced from IRS transaction codes 764, 765 and 768 as stated in the table footnote.
variables.universe: EITC claims processed through the stated cycle
variables.suppression_rules: Displayed totals are rounded using M/B notation; exact dollars are not supplied.
variables.comparability_notes: Net tax credit amount is not gross income, SNAP benefit, college aid or disposable income. Tax-law changes affect year-to-year trends.

variables.label: Average EITC amount per claim
variables.definition: Average net EITC amount among EITC claims for the jurisdiction.
variables.universe: EITC claims processed through the stated cycle
variables.suppression_rules: Displayed as rounded dollars; may not exactly equal the quotient of separately rounded total and count.
variables.comparability_notes: Mean among claimants, not per resident or per low-income household; use claim count as denominator.

crosswalk_hints.notes: Crosswalk only at aggregate jurisdiction/year level. Claims are annual tax returns, unlike SNAP/TANF person-month or household-month cases.

variables.suppression_rules: None stated in portal metadata.
variables.comparability_notes: Confirm Delaware library fiscal-year definition before aligning to calendar/academic year.

variables.label: Library
variables.definition: Name of the public library represented by the row.
variables.comparability_notes: Library names/organizations can change; use a stable library identifier if supplied in a new extract.

variables.label: Service Type
variables.definition: Type of library service being counted across Dewey subject categories; portal description identifies programs, questions asked of staff and circulation.
variables.comparability_notes: Service type determines the unit of each Dewey numeric column; values cannot be combined across types without labeling units.

variables.label: Computers and eBooks (000)
variables.definition: Count for the row's service type in the dataset's 000/computers-and-eBooks category.
missing_codes: Blank/null if not reported; exact rule in attached dictionary
variables.comparability_notes: Dataset label is not a pure Dewey 000 bibliographic class because it explicitly combines computers and eBooks; do not merge with physical 000 circulation without checking service_type.

variables.source_variable_name: philosophy_and_psychology_100 / world_religions_200 / social_sciences_300 / language_400 / science_500 / applied_science_600 / arts_700 / literature_800 / history_and_geography_900
variables.label: Dewey subject-area service counts
variables.definition: Nine numeric fields giving the row's service-type count for Dewey hundreds categories 100 through 900.
missing_codes: Blank/null if not reported; exact rule in attached dictionary
variables.comparability_notes: All nine share numeric type but their unit comes from service_type. Dewey labeling/classification practices may change over time.

variables.source_variable_name: Circulation / Visits (Gate-Count) / Reference Transactions / Program Attendance / Public Computer Sessions
variables.label: Library profile output measures
variables.definition: Separate annual output counts for circulation, physical visits, reference transactions, program attendees and public computer sessions.
variables.unit: transactions, visits, attendees or sessions depending on measure
variables.geography: Individual Delaware library or county profile
missing_codes: Dash in profile may represent unreported; FY2013 values substituted for some missing FY2014 measures
variables.suppression_rules: No suppression rule stated; profile footnote documents substitution for missing measures.
variables.comparability_notes: These are distinct units. Program attendance may count repeat attendees; circulation counts loans, not titles/patrons.

variables.label: Total public contacts
variables.definition: Derived profile total equal to Circulation + Gate Count + Reference Transactions + Program Attendance + Computer Sessions.
variables.geography: Individual Delaware library or county profile
variables.suppression_rules: Components may include prior-year substitution as profile-footnoted.
variables.comparability_notes: This additive index mixes transactions, visits, attendances and sessions; do not interpret as unique people.

variables.source_variable_name: library_id / reporting_period / metric_name / metric_value / metric_unit / age_audience / program_type
variables.label: Proposed current library activity extract
variables.definition: Long-format comparison schema for current circulation, usage and program attendance, with stable library ID and explicit metric unit/audience.
variables.universe: Requested Delaware Libraries current aggregate data
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate patron activity; exclude patron IDs, titles linked to patrons and exact event attendance records where disclosure risk exists.
variables.comparability_notes: Metric unit and deduplication are mandatory. A program event, attendance and unique attendee are different measures.
variables.inference_basis: The official site names public usage families, but no current requested-extract layout or stable library/program code list is published.

source_variable_names: Circulation / Visits (Gate-Count) / Reference Transactions / Program Attendance / Public Computer Sessions
library_id / reporting_period / metric_name / metric_value / metric_unit / age_audience / program_type
crosswalk_hints.notes: NSCH K10Q14 measures perceived neighborhood availability, not use. Join only at compatible geography and label access versus utilization.
Attendance is likely event instances, unlike unique survey respondents or assistance-program participants; request unique-attendee rules before comparison.

sources.research_notes: Historical public schemas and profiles exist, but the catalog's current detailed books/circulation/program-attendance source remains request-only. The Dewey dataset is stale (FY2014-2017) and service_type controls the numeric unit. Profiles explicitly mix current/prior-year values when fields were unreported. A new delivery should include library identifiers, metric units, physical/electronic distinction, program audience/type, uniqueness/deduplication, estimate/substitution flags and reporting-calendar definitions.

codebook_artifacts.title: 2025 Annual Progress and Services Report
codebook_artifacts.format: PDF report with child-welfare tables and definitions
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware DSCYF Division of Family Services
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Primarily SFY2018-SFY2023 summary and federal performance measures
codebook_artifacts.notes: Direct evidence for intake, accepted/substantiated reports, treatment and foster-care measures.

codebook_artifacts.title: Request Department Records
codebook_artifacts.notes: States DFS files are confidential and not subject to FOIA; individuals may request only their own records through authorization procedures. Aggregate research data require separate agency approval.

codebook_artifacts.title: Office of Children's Services
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware DSCYF Division of Family Services
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Intake, urgent response and investigation scope
codebook_artifacts.notes: Defines receipt/screening of abuse, neglect and dependency reports and response functions.

variables.source_variable_name: Reports of abuse, neglect and dependency received
variables.label: Hotline/intake reports received
variables.definition: Number of abuse, neglect and dependency reports received in the state fiscal year.
variables.suppression_rules: Only aggregate totals published; underlying files are confidential.
variables.comparability_notes: Reports are allegations/intakes, not unique children, families, investigations or confirmed victims; multiple reports may concern the same child.

variables.source_variable_name: Reports accepted as screened in for investigation
variables.label: Accepted/screened-in reports
variables.definition: Number and percent of received reports screened in for investigation.
variables.universe: DFS reports received in the state fiscal year
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication only.
variables.comparability_notes: Screened-in is a process disposition, not substantiation. Policy/tool changes can alter acceptance rates.

variables.label: Substantiated investigations
variables.definition: Completed investigations resulting in substantiation of abuse, neglect or dependency; report shows count and percent of accepted reports.
variables.universe: Accepted/screened-in reports/investigations in the state fiscal year
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication only.
variables.comparability_notes: The percent denominator is accepted reports, unlike child-victim rate per 1,000; investigation and child units can differ.

variables.source_variable_name: Families and children received treatment services
variables.label: Families and children receiving treatment services
variables.definition: Published annual count labeled as families and children receiving DFS treatment services.
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication only.
variables.comparability_notes: The label combines families and children; do not reinterpret as unique persons without clarification.

variables.source_variable_name: Average Monthly FC placement / Initial entry into care / Exits from care / At least 1 day in care / Number in out-of-home care on 9/30
variables.label: Foster-care flow and stock measures
variables.definition: Five separate measures: average monthly foster-care placement, initial entries, exits, children with at least one day in care, and children in out-of-home care on September 30.
variables.unit: children or average monthly placements, measure-specific
variables.universe: Children in Delaware foster/out-of-home care under the report definition
variables.time_granularity: state fiscal year or September 30 point-in-time
categories: At least one day in care
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication only.
variables.comparability_notes: Flow, any-time and point-in-time measures have different denominators; do not sum or compare as though they are one caseload count.

variables.source_variable_name: Percentage adopted within 24 months of entry
variables.label: Adoption within 24 months
variables.definition: Percentage of the applicable entry cohort adopted within 24 months of entering care.
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication only.
variables.comparability_notes: Cohort outcome with follow-up, not annual adoptions. Cohort maturity and definition must match across years.

variables.label: Adoptions completed
variables.definition: Number of Delaware children who found permanent families through adoption during calendar year 2025 (75).
variables.universe: Delaware children adopted through DFS during calendar year
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication only.
variables.comparability_notes: Calendar-year completed adoptions are not the same as the cohort percentage adopted within 24 months or the fiscal-year exits-to-adoption measure.

variables.label: Proposed de-identified maltreatment process fields
variables.definition: Requested aggregate dimensions for allegation type, intake screening outcome and completed investigation finding.
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate and apply DSCYF small-cell/complementary suppression; no child, reporter, caregiver or alleged perpetrator identifiers.
variables.comparability_notes: Report, allegation and investigation are different row units; one report can include multiple children/allegations.
variables.inference_basis: The APSR publishes these concepts in cross-tabs, but no record-level FOCUS field names/codebook were found.

variables.label: Proposed foster-care episode aggregate fields
variables.definition: Non-identifying dimensions for placement/episode flows and outcomes, aggregated to period and age group.
categories: Placement type and exit reason to be supplied from DSCYF codebook
Age groups rather than date of birth
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate; suppress sparse age-placement-region-time combinations; exclude exact dates and identifiers.
variables.comparability_notes: Placements can exceed unique children; episode entries/exits differ from point-in-time caseload.
variables.inference_basis: Published foster-care measures imply episode/placement data in FOCUS, but exact fields and code lists are not public.

source_variable_names: Reports of abuse, neglect and dependency received
Reports accepted as screened in for investigation
crosswalk_hints.notes: Build a process funnel only after aligning report/investigation/child units and denominators; substantiation percentage uses accepted reports in the APSR table.

source_variable_names: Average Monthly FC placement / Initial entry into care / Exits from care / At least 1 day in care / Number in out-of-home care on 9/30
crosswalk_hints.notes: Store stock, flow, episode and unique-child measures separately. NSCH family structure is not foster placement status.

sources.research_notes: Public APSR and annual-report tables provide a strong aggregate dictionary, but the requested detailed abuse/neglect/foster-care data remain confidential/request-only. DFS personal files are explicitly not subject to FOIA. Any research release should be aggregate, distinguish reports/allegations/investigations/children/families/placements, supply FOCUS code lists and policy-vintage metadata, and apply agency small-cell/complementary suppression.

codebook_artifacts.title: Delaware State Police Reports / Statistics
codebook_artifacts.format: HTML index with annual and traffic statistical report PDFs, 2005-present traffic series
codebook_artifacts.notes: No incident/citation-level traffic-violation dictionary or export was located.

codebook_artifacts.applies_to: DSP traffic enforcement in calendar year 2025 with multi-year comparisons
codebook_artifacts.notes: Direct definitions for arrest categories, troop tables, DUI/BAC/age/sex tables and statutory list for aggressive driving.

codebook_artifacts.title: Delaware State Police FOIA
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Request route for detailed public records/data
codebook_artifacts.notes: Detailed violation data should be requested with field dictionary, disclosure limitations and record-unit definition.

codebook_artifacts.title: Delaware Public Crash Data by County
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Department of Safety and Homeland Security
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Related public crash-event data, not traffic violations
codebook_artifacts.notes: Useful only as a related-schema comparison. The portal states official crash reports are confidential and not public records; crashes and enforcement violations are different event families.

variables.label: Total traffic arrests
variables.definition: Total DSP traffic enforcement arrests/citations reported for the calendar year (123,243 in 2025).
variables.universe: Delaware State Police traffic enforcement, DSP only
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication; no suppression rule stated.
variables.comparability_notes: The report uses 'arrests' for enforcement counts/citations; not unique drivers and not criminal arrests in general.

variables.label: DUI arrests
variables.definition: DSP arrests for driving under the influence during the calendar year (2,977 in 2025).
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication.
variables.comparability_notes: Arrests are enforcement events, not unique people, convictions, crashes or BAC tests obtained.

variables.source_variable_name: Speed Arrests / 55 MPH Speed Arrests / 65 MPH Speed Arrests
variables.label: Speed-enforcement arrests
variables.definition: Total speeding arrests and subsets reported for 55-mph and 65-mph zones, including troop breakdown tables.
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication.
variables.comparability_notes: 55/65-mph counts are subsets of Speed Arrests; do not add them to total speed arrests. Other speed-limit zones remain in total.

variables.source_variable_name: D.M.V. Arrests / Dangerous Moving Violation Arrests
variables.label: Dangerous moving violation arrests
variables.definition: DSP dangerous-moving-violation enforcement count; report footnote says it includes speeding and DUI arrests plus other moving violations.
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication.
variables.comparability_notes: This is an overlapping composite containing speed and DUI; it must not be summed with its component categories.

variables.label: Aggressive-driving-related arrests
variables.definition: Composite enforcement count for the Title 21 sections enumerated in the report footnote (including 4107a, 4117, 4120b, 4122-1, 4123, 4132, 4133, 4155, 4164, 4168, 4169, 4175a and 4175A).
variables.universe: DSP enforcement records matching enumerated statutes
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication.
variables.comparability_notes: Potentially overlaps speed/dangerous-moving counts; compare only with identical statute list and counting rules.

variables.source_variable_name: Primary Seatbelt Arrests / Seat Belt Assessments
variables.label: Seat-belt enforcement
variables.definition: Separate counts for primary seat-belt arrests and secondary-violation seat-belt assessments as labeled in the troop tables.
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication.
variables.comparability_notes: Primary arrests and secondary assessments are legally/operationally different; keep separate.

variables.label: License and registration arrests
variables.definition: DSP traffic enforcement arrests for license and registration violations.
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication.
variables.comparability_notes: Composite label; exact statute/offense breakdown requires detailed requested data.

variables.label: DSP troop/special unit
variables.definition: Organizational unit used in traffic-arrest breakdowns.
variables.comparability_notes: Troop is an organizational/enforcement geography, not county or driver residence; Special Units are not a fixed geographic area.

variables.source_variable_name: DUI age / sex / BAC status and band
variables.label: DUI arrest demographics and BAC result
variables.definition: Published DUI tables cross-tab arrests by age and sex and classify BAC as obtained/not obtained, implied-consent refusal, not applicable, or into BAC bands.
variables.universe: 2025 DSP DUI arrests; specific tables have known-age/BAC-result restrictions
categories: BAC not applicable for drug-only or alcohol-consumption-while-driving arrests
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate publication.
variables.comparability_notes: BAC-obtained denominator excludes not obtained/refusal/not-applicable; drug-only DUI is explicitly BAC-not-applicable.

variables.source_variable_name: violation_date / statute_code / offense_description / troop / location_area / disposition
variables.label: Proposed de-identified traffic-violation record fields
variables.definition: Requested event-level or aggregate dimensions for violation timing, exact Title 21 statute, offense description, enforcing unit, coarse location and case/citation disposition.
variables.geography: Troop/coarse location; no exact personal address
categories: Exact statute/offense and disposition code lists must be supplied by DSP
variables.suppression_rules: Remove names, license/vehicle identifiers, exact addresses and narrative; aggregate/suppress sparse cells under DSP policy and law.
variables.comparability_notes: One stop/event can produce multiple charges; define whether one row is stop, citation, charge, arrest or person. Disposition may be held outside DSP.
variables.inference_basis: The annual report proves statute and troop dimensions exist in aggregates, but no public violation-record schema or codebook was found.

source_variable_names: Speed Arrests / 55 MPH Speed Arrests / 65 MPH Speed Arrests
D.M.V. Arrests / Dangerous Moving Violation Arrests
Primary Seatbelt Arrests / Seat Belt Assessments
crosswalk_hints.notes: Composite categories overlap. Store statute/category hierarchy and never sum Total with components or overlapping composites.

source_variable_names: violation_date / statute_code / offense_description / troop / location_area / disposition
crosswalk_hints.notes: Violations are enforcement events; Delaware public crash data are crash events. Link only through aggregate time/geography, not by assuming one violation per crash.

sources.research_notes: DSP publishes extensive annual aggregate tables but no citation/charge-level public dictionary. The catalog source remains request-only. Key published composites overlap: dangerous moving violations include speed and DUI, and aggressive driving is defined by a statute list. A detailed delivery must state the row unit, multiple-charge handling, statute version, officer/troop versus event geography, void/dismissed/pending treatment, uniqueness rules and disclosure controls.
